abstract: Is declining news consumption among young people inevitable? This column reports on a large-scale randomised controlled trial in France to test whether free access to a major newspaper and teacher training in media education can boost newspaper reading among high-school students. Providing free access to Le Monde led to a persistent increase in news consumption, and a large increase in news knowledge among students enrolled in disadvantaged high schools in particular, suggesting that access to high-quality news and media education can contribute to reducing socioeconomic inequalities in news knowledge.
abstract_zh: 年轻人新闻消费的下降是否不可避免？本专栏报告了在法国开展的一项大规模随机对照试验，旨在检验免费获取一份主流报纸以及教师接受媒体教育培训能否提升高中生的报纸阅读量。提供免费获取《世界报》的机会带来了新闻消费的持续增长，尤其是在就读于弱势高中的学生中，新闻知识大幅增加，这表明获取高质量新闻和接受媒体教育有助于缩小新闻知识方面的社会经济不平等。
authors: Simon Briole, Julia Cage, Andrea Prat
title: Mission impossible: Making teenagers read newspapers
title_zh: 不可能的任务：让青少年阅读报纸

abstract: We compare and combine two distinct approaches to estimating market power in the US brewing industry—one based on production data, the other on demand. Both methods produce similar estimates of average markups and reveal a recent upward trend. We then combine the two approaches in two ways. First, we replace conventional instruments in demand estimation with a moment involving a production-based markup estimate, yielding similar results. We then evaluate the common (but controversial) assumption that retail markets operate competitively, finding that demand-based markups recovered with the assumption of competitive retail markets align with production-based estimates, as long as downstream costs are accounted for.
abstract_zh: 我们比较并结合了两种估计美国酿酒业市场势力的不同方法——一种基于生产数据，另一种基于需求。两种方法得出的平均加成估计相似，并揭示了近期的上升趋势。随后，我们以两种方式将这两种方法结合起来。
title: Markup Estimation using Production and Demand Data: An Application to the US Brewing Industry
title_zh: 基于生产与需求数据的加成率估计：以美国酿酒业为例

title: The impact of gifts on tips and time spent in restaurants: A field experiment
title_zh: 礼物对餐厅小费及停留时间的影响：一项实地实验

abstract: Wage violations against H‐1B visa holders (i.e., cutting their wages below a legally required prevailing wage) are analysed using detailed firm‐level data. The incidence of violations is 25%–35% lower in a monopsony versus a competitive labour market, and 60% of firms with at least one violation are subcontractors. A new theoretical model provides an interpretation for these findings, predicting that violations are more likely when firms have less labour market power and generally wherever firm profit margins are more vulnerable to a negative shock (e.g., in subcontractors that have been outsourced work and firms seeking to hire lower‐skilled workers).
abstract_zh: 本文利用详细的企業層面數據，分析了針對H-1B簽證持有者的工資違法行為（即將其工資削減至低於法定現行工資標準）。在買方壟斷勞動力市場中，違法行為的發生率比競爭性勞動力市場低25%–35%，而在至少存在一起違法行為的企業中，60%為分包商。一個新的理論模型為這些發現提供了詮釋，預測當企業的勞動力市場勢力較弱時，違法行為更可能發生；並且一般而言，凡是企業利潤率更易受到負面衝擊影響的情形（例如，承接外包工作的分包商以及試圖僱用較低技能工人的企業），違法行為也更為普遍。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Wage Theft, Market Power, and Outsourcing: The Case of H‐1B Workers
title_zh: 工资盗窃、市场势力与外包：H-1B工人的案例

abstract: This paper investigates the animal-spirits hypothesis by analyzing the role of consumer sentiment as an independent determinant of consumption growth. We estimate an approximate dynamic factor model that captures the common unobserved component of consumption growth across durable goods, nondurable goods, and services. The dynamic factor extracted from the model closely tracks the independently measured University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index (UMICS). Because this factor is orthogonal to the other macroeconomic predictors in the model, our findings provide additional support for the role of consumer confidence as a standalone determinant of consumption growth, offering further empirical evidence for the animal-spirits hypothesis. Our results also imply that the common dynamic factor extracted from the proposed model can be viewed as an index of consumer confidence, although survey-based approaches still retain the advantage of earlier availability in the U.S.
title: Animal-spirits hypothesis of consumer sentiment: New evidence from a dynamic factor model of consumption
title_zh: 消费者信心的动物精神假说：来自消费动态因子模型的新证据

abstract: Violent conflict is globally on the rise, and an increasing body of literature analyses its impacts on agricultural production and food security. Yet the quality of data collected in conflict zones is sometimes questioned and remains underexplored. This paper addresses this gap by examining two types of reporting bias—recall and question order bias—under varying levels of conflict in Myanmar. We focus on agricultural wages as the key variable of interest because wages are frequently measured in surveys and represent an important development indicator, serving as both a key input cost for farmers and a crucial income source for hired farm workers. We match ACLED conflict data with farm survey data collected across three panel rounds, with the third round including recall modules to assess recall bias. We also implement a question order experiment in the second round to assess whether the sequencing of wage questions by year and gender influences reported wages. We find modest recall bias in reported wages, but no statistically significant evidence that recall bias increases with conflict severity and only limited evidence of question order bias. Among the question order biases, only the interaction between conflict severity and asking about the previous year's wage first is statistically significant, and its magnitude is economically small. Overall reporting biases are modest and are driven more by the type of wage being reported than by conflict severity. We conclude that reliable data can be collected in conflict settings—and such data are rare but essential for evidence‐based policies and interventions as conflicts continue to rise globally.
abstract_zh: 暴力冲突在全球范围内呈上升趋势，越来越多的文献分析其对农业生产和粮食安全的影响。然而，在冲突地区收集的数据质量有时受到质疑，且相关研究仍不充分。本文通过考察缅甸不同冲突程度下的两类报告偏差——回忆偏差和问题顺序偏差——来填补这一空白。我们聚焦农业工资作为关键关注变量，因为工资在调查中经常被测量，且是一项重要的发展指标，既是农民的关键投入成本，也是受雇农业工人的重要收入来源。我们将ACLED冲突数据与三轮面板调查中收集的农场调查数据进行匹配，其中第三轮包含回忆模块以评估回忆偏差。我们还在第二轮中实施了问题顺序实验，以评估按年份和性别排列工资问题的顺序是否会影响报告的工资。我们发现报告工资中存在适度的回忆偏差，但没有统计上显著的证据表明回忆偏差随冲突严重程度而增加，且仅有有限的证据表明存在问题顺序偏差。在问题顺序偏差中，只有冲突严重程度与首先询问上一年工资之间的交互作用具有统计显著性，且其幅度在经济意义上较小。总体而言，报告偏差较为适度，且更多由所报告的工资类型驱动，而非冲突严重程度。我们得出结论：在冲突环境中可以收集到可靠数据——此类数据虽然稀少，但在全球冲突持续上升的背景下，对于基于证据的政策和干预措施至关重要。
title: Measuring Agricultural Wages Amidst Conflict: Evidence From Myanmar
title_zh: 衡量冲突中的农业工资：来自缅甸的证据

abstract: This paper reassesses the relationship between FDI and economic growth in emerging and developing economies. We show that the aggregate FDI-growth relationship is not stable over time and that complementarities documented using data from the 1970s and 1980s disappear in more recent decades. Building a new sectoral FDI dataset we document substantial heterogeneity between FDI and sectoral growth and show that there is a positive association in the primary sector, no robust relationship in the secondary sector, and a negative relationship in the tertiary sector. To interpret these patterns, we examine the role of global value chains (GVCs). FDI is most strongly associated with growth in country–sectors with low GVC participation, while this relationship weakens or disappears as GVC integration increases. The effects also depend on the type of GVC integration. We conclude that the elusive aggregate FDI-growth relationship reflects how FDI is embedded in global production networks.
abstract_zh: 本文重新评估了新兴经济体和发展中经济体中FDI与经济增长之间的关系。我们发现，FDI与经济增长的总体关系并不随时间保持稳定，基于20世纪70年代和80年代数据所记录的互补性在近几十年中已经消失。通过构建一个新的部门FDI数据集，我们记录了FDI与部门增长之间存在显著的异质性，并表明第一产业中存在正向关联，第二产业中不存在稳健关系，而第三产业中则存在负向关系。为解释这些模式，我们考察了全球价值链（GVCs）的作用。FDI与GVC参与度较低的国家—部门增长之间的关联最为显著，而随着GVC整合程度的提高，这一关系减弱甚至消失。这些效应还取决于GVC整合的类型。我们得出结论，难以捉摸的FDI与增长总体关系反映了FDI嵌入全球生产网络的方式。
title: The elusive link between FDI and economic growth: Sectoral heterogeneity and global value chains
title_zh: 外国直接投资与经济增长之间难以捉摸的联系：部门异质性与全球价值链

abstract: Automation technologies can affect wage inequality differently even when they automate the same measure of tasks. This paper studies a task-assignment model in which capital performs an endogenous interior interval of tasks. A uniform rise in machine productivity expands that interval from both sides. A rightward shift in the location of peak machine productivity moves both boundaries to the right and lowers the skill premium, while automated width may expand, contract, or remain locally unchanged. A closed-form boundary formula explains why the location of machine improvements matters separately from automated extent.
abstract_zh: 自动化技术即使自动化了相同数量的任务，也可能以不同方式影响工资不平等。本文研究了一个任务分配模型，其中资本执行一个内生内部区间的任务。机器生产率的均匀上升会从两侧扩展该区间。机器生产率峰值位置的右移会使两个边界都向右移动，并降低技能溢价，而自动化宽度可能扩大、收缩或局部保持不变。一个闭式边界公式解释了为何机器改进的位置会与自动化程度分别产生影响。
title: Where machines improve: Automation direction, task boundaries, and the skill premium
title_zh: 机器改进之处：自动化方向、任务边界与技能溢价
